# Fetch all albums in the library to map album_id -> genre
albums = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    albums.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Build mapping album_id -> genre
album_genre = {album['album_id']: album['genre'] for album in albums}
print("Albums:", albums)
print("Album genre mapping:", album_genre)

steps.code:
# Filter liked songs that belong to albums in the album library
library_album_ids = set(album_genre.keys())
liked_in_library = [song for song in liked_songs if song['album_id'] in library_album_ids]
print("Liked songs in library:", len(liked_in_library))

# Count per genre
from collections import Counter
genre_counts = Counter()
for song in liked_in_library:
    genre = album_genre[song['album_id']]
    genre_counts[genre] += 1

print("Genre counts:", dict(genre_counts))
# Find genre(s) with minimum count
min_count = min(genre_counts.values())
least_genres = [g for g, c in genre_counts.items() if c == min_count]
print("Least liked genre(s):", least_genres, "with count", min_count)
